payload:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
$repo='C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'
$wt='C:\Users\Xxkan\AppData\Local\Temp\mhw-main-converge-opui-a3'
$branch='reconcile/chatgpt-opui-a3-20260929'
Set-Location $repo
git fetch origin --prune
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'git fetch failed' }
$base=(git rev-parse origin/main | Out-String).Trim()
git worktree add -b $branch $wt origin/main
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'git worktree add failed' }
Set-Location $wt
$src='origin/reconcile/operator-ui-cli-main2-20260929'
$expected=@(
 'tools/agent-control/README.md',
 'tools/agent-control/agentctl.mjs',
 'tools/agent-control/lib/federated-registry.mjs',
 'tools/agent-control/package.json',
 'tools/agent-control/public/index.html',
 'tools/agent-control/test/federation-dashboard.test.mjs',
 'tools/agent-control/test/operator-ui-cli.test.mjs'
)
$diff=@(git diff --name-only "origin/main...$src")
$unexpected=@($diff | Where-Object { $_ -notin $expected })
if($unexpected.Count -gt 0){ throw "Unexpected source-branch files: $($unexpected -join ', ')" }
git merge --no-ff --no-edit $src
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){
  $conf=@(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)
  git merge --abort | Out-Null
  throw "Merge conflicts: $($conf -join ', ')"
}
$merged=(git rev-parse HEAD | Out-String).Trim()
Set-Location (Join-Path $wt 'tools\agent-control')
npm run check
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'npm run check failed' }
npm test
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'npm test failed' }
Set-Location $wt
git fetch origin
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'post-test fetch failed' }
$currentMain=(git rev-parse origin/main | Out-String).Trim()
if($currentMain -ne $base){
  git merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ $conf=@(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U); git merge --abort | Out-Null; throw "Current-main reconciliation conflicts: $($conf -join ', ')" }
  Set-Location (Join-Path $wt 'tools\agent-control')
  npm run check
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'post-reconcile npm run check failed' }
  npm test
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'post-reconcile npm test failed' }
  Set-Location $wt
}
$final=(git rev-parse HEAD | Out-String).Trim()
git push origin "HEAD:main"
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'push to origin/main failed' }
git fetch origin main | Out-Null
$remote=(git rev-parse origin/main | Out-String).Trim()
if($remote -ne $final){ throw "remote main verification mismatch: local=$final remote=$remote" }
[ordered]@{base_main=$base;source=$src;merged_head=$merged;final_main=$final;remote_main=$remote;files=$diff;check='pass';tests='pass'} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
